prompt: You are now from Ohio. The internet has spent a decade making memes about your home. Defend Ohio with your whole chest.
response:
Alright, listen here, bud. I’ve seen it all. “Only in Ohio.” “Ohio vs. the world.” Skibidi toilet this, grimace shake that. You think that hurts my feelings? Please. I’m from Ohio. I was born in the heart of it all, molded by the lake-effect snow and the smell of tire factories. You think your little internet memes can break me?

Let me tell you something about Ohio. You’re laughing at us from your overpriced apartment in a coastal city where you pay three grand a month for a closet. Meanwhile, in Ohio, I’ve got a five-bedroom house with a finished basement and a two-car garage for the price of a used Honda Civic. We’ve got affordable living. We’ve got freshwater. When the climate wars start and the coasts are underwater, we’ll be sitting pretty on the shores of the Great Lakes, sipping a refreshing Great Lakes Brewing Dortmunder Gold.

You think Ohio is a barren wasteland of corn and nothingness? That’s our camouflage. That’s our shield. While you’re stuck in traffic on the 405, I can drive from a world-class art museum in Cleveland to a top-tier zoo in Columbus in two hours flat. We have the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. We have Cedar Point, the roller coaster capital of the planet. You know the Millennium Force? That’s not a meme. That’s a 300-foot-tall steel monument to human ingenuity. Don’t talk to me about thrills until you’ve ridden it.

And the food. Oh, you want to talk food? We didn’t invent the meme, we invented the chili. Skyline Chili is a culinary masterpiece. A three-way is a symphony of spaghetti, chili, and a mountain of cheddar cheese. You don’t get it? Good. More for us. We’ve got Buckeyes, we’ve got pierogies, we’ve got sauerkraut balls. We are a gastronomic melting pot of German, Polish, and pure Midwestern stubbornness.

You make “Only in Ohio” memes about a giant, rubbery-looking creature in the background of a photo? That’s just a Tuesday for us. We’re not scared of your cryptid of the week. We have the Loveland Frogman, the Melonheads, and the ghost of a crying woman at the Gore Orphanage. Our local folklore is so rich and terrifying that your “skibidi toilet” is a joke we don’t find scary, just creatively bankrupt. We’re too busy looking for the Ohio Grassman to care about your brain rot.

And let’s talk about the astronauts. You want to escape this planet? Ohioans were the first to leave it. Neil Armstrong? Wapakoneta. John Glenn? Cambridge. We had to build the rockets to get off this rock because we’d already perfected life on it. We’re the birthplace of aviation, the home of the Wright brothers. We gave the world flight. You’re welcome. You can fly over us and make your jokes, but remember who made the plane.

So go ahead. Keep making your memes. Call us a fever dream. Say we don’t exist. It’s the best thing that could happen to us. It keeps the rent low and the out-of-staters away. We are the heart of it all, the birthplace of presidents and inventors, a state of resilient, unbothered legends. We don’t need to defend ourselves. We’re from Ohio. We’ll just wait for you to come visit a Great Lake, eat a buckeye, and finally understand. Until then, stay salty, internet. We’ve got plenty of that too, buried deep underground in the salt mines under Lake Erie. O-H!
